result.hard_numeric_fact_text: CALCULATION (dossier from reported results): Q1 FY27 revenue +36.8% YoY, EBITDA +97%, margin 25.3% (+7.7 pts), PAT +105.6%. FACT: FY26 revenue Rs1,535.85 cr vs Rs1,571.82 cr (-2%); Q4 FY26 revenue Rs386.91 cr (NSE 5 May 2026). Q1 FY27 statement text is truncated in the filings file.

risk.cycle: MEDIUM-HIGH: margin jump is driven by pass-through of war-driven ammonia price rise (Rs50 to >Rs100/kg) and tight competitor supply; FY26 volume was flat

result.thesis: Margins and profit rebounded sharply in Q1 FY27 (EBITDA margin 25.3%, PAT roughly doubled) after a flat FY26 with volume down ~1%. Management says the gain is price-led: raw-material (ammonia) costs doubled and were passed on, and it expects prices not to revert quickly. That is a cost-push spread, not demonstrated volume or capacity growth. Balance sheet and cash conversion are excellent (CFO/PAT 1.33), but at 40.8x TTM P/E the stock already capitalises a normalised, higher earnings base. No capacity catalyst in the filings. Positive but not asymmetric.
chain_missing_links: Volume growth: FY26 flat; Q1 volume unknown
Capacity/new product catalyst: none in filings
Sustainability of spreads once ammonia normalises
Consensus revisions: unknown (a Motilal Oswal FY27E EBITDA margin of ~20.8% predates the Q1 print; ANALYST ESTIMATE, secondary)
result.demand_signal: MANAGEMENT CLAIM: market not growing as fast as hoped; share retained/slightly up; FY26 volume ~-1%. Mgmt expects 5-10% volume growth (secondary source).
result.supply_signal: MANAGEMENT CLAIM: ammonia sourcing disrupted for 1-2 weeks in March; competitors face the same constraints, so price hikes hold for a while.
result.pricing_signal: FACT (via dossier): EBITDA margin 25.3% vs 17.6% a year ago; mgmt raised finished-goods prices to protect margins; amines are a minor 'C item' cost for customers.
result.capacity_catalyst: Unknown: no commissioning in the filings supplied.
result.valuation: Mkt cap Rs9,435 cr; TTM P/E 40.8; EV/EBITDA 30.1. CALCULATION: Q1 PAT ~Rs94.5 cr gives annualised EPS ~Rs74 (~25x) at the peak margin; TTM EPS ~Rs45.

plausible.2x: NO: needs FY28 EPS ~Rs90 at 42x, i.e. margins above 25% plus 15% volume growth.

kill_conditions: EBITDA margin back below 18% for two quarters
Volume growth negative YoY for two quarters
Ammonia price normalises and finished-goods prices are cut
result.biggest_risk: Price-led margin gain reverses when ammonia and competitor supply normalise, leaving a 40x multiple on lower earnings.
result.next_datapoint: Q2 FY27: volume growth and EBITDA margin vs 25.3%; ammonia price trend.

bear.assumptions: Spreads normalise toward FY26 (EPS ~Rs38); P/E de-rates to 32x

base.assumptions: Partial hold of margin ~21-22% and 7% volume growth; FY28 EPS Rs58 at 38x

bull.assumptions: Margins ~24% plus new volumes; EPS Rs72 at 42x

extreme_bull.assumptions: Q1 annualised EPS (~Rs74) sustained with growth; EPS 90 at 45x
